title: Kiosk schema descriptor
description: The value of the kind:"value" envelope returned by GET /kiosk/schema.

verbs.description: The invariant four verbs (query, run, pay, schema), always all present -- the protocol surface itself, NOT the served subset. The served subset is `capabilities` in /.well-known/kiosk.json.

description.description: Human-facing description or null. SEMANTICS live here in prose -- what the verb does, when to reach for it, what the result means. Names, types and constraints do not: they live in input_schema.

params.description: RETIRED free-form provider-defined hint object (by convention name -> type-hint string), or null. Never a validation contract, and no longer the input contract: publish null, or omit the key. Retained on the wire so descriptors written before the retirement still validate -- an AI assistant MAY read a non-null value as a prose hint for a verb that publishes no input_schema, and MUST prefer input_schema wherever one is published.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for THIS verb's inputs: names, required/optional, types, enums, ranges. Where present it is the AUTHORITATIVE input contract for the verb -- the only place a parameter name is declared -- and it wins over any `params` hint that disagrees. OPTIONAL in this version of the descriptor only because the reference implementation does not yet publish one on every registered verb; the descriptor house style already requires one on every query and action, and a later version is expected to make it REQUIRED. Absent = no machine input contract published for this verb.

example_params.description: OPTIONAL example params object an AI assistant can copy verbatim as a starting call for this verb. It ILLUSTRATES input_schema and is not the contract: where the two disagree, the schema is right.

example_row.description: OPTIONAL example of one result element -- a representative row for a query, or the example return value for an action -- so an assistant learns the result shape without a call-and-observe probe.
